title: Harden SFTP Client module (security review phase 1)
summary: The SFTP Client module hardens security by removing MD5 fingerprint support, adding a 25 MB file-size limit, disabling debugging, and applying NonDebuggable attributes to sensitive code paths. The SFTP Connector now only accepts SHA256 fingerprints.
key_points: MD5 host-key fingerprints are no longer supported; only SHA256 prefixes accepted
File upload and download operations are capped at 25 MB with a typed File Too Large exception
Debugging is disabled and sensitive code paths marked NonDebuggable to protect customer data
Generic exception branch no longer exposes raw server or .NET exception text
Telemetry event SFTP-0001 added to track file transfer sizes
quote: Remove MD5 host-key fingerprint support end-to-end.
